<details>
<summary>Text Transcrip</summary>

The UltraRituals plugin allows you to create rituals to spawn any boss, enabling you to build altars out of any type of block (including 3D models) that require a specific item to start the ritual.
In this **free version**, you can create a maximum of 1 ritual with 2 altars.

**ANIMATIONS**
The plugin features a ton of particle animations to use on the altars.

**COMMANDS**
```
/ultrarituals create <id>
/ultrarituals edit <id>
  /ultrarituals setname <name>
  /ultrarituals setmob <name>  
  /ultrarituals setcooldown <sec>
  /ultrarituals setdelay <sec>
  /ultrarituals setspawn
  /ultrarituals leave
/ultrarituals save
/ultrarituals list
```
**PLACEHOLDERS**

  Internal
```
    %player%
    %ritual_id%
    %ritual_name%
    %ritual_active%
    %active_altars%
    %total_altars%
```    
  PlaceholderAPI
```
    %ultrarituals_name_<id>%
    %ultrarituals_id_<id>%
    %ultrarituals_active_<id>%
    %ultrarituals_status_<id>%
    %ultrarituals_altars_<id>%
    %ultrarituals_cooldown_<id>%
```
For any questions, you can ask on our Discord server. https://discord.gg/ZdhHrURycn

If you want to create more rituals, you can check out the premium version here:
[UltraRituals](https://builtbybit.com/resources/ultrarituals.106120/)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Creation Steps</summary>


```
**First Step**
  You mus use the command: /ultrarituals create <name> (you are now entering edit mode)
    
**Second Step**
  Now you must place the altars; grab your favourite block and place it
  We recommend respawn anchor or trial spawners

  Once placed, a configuration panel will appear where you can set up the required item, animations, cinematics, etc.
  
**Third Step**
  Specify the MythicMobs internal name for the ritual spawn using the command: /ultrarituals setmob <name> 
  Specify the mob's spawn location using the command: /ultrarituals setspawn
  
**Final Step**
  Once everything is set up, you must save the ritual using the command: /ultrarituals save
```

</details>
